SECURITY INFORMATION

Security is one of the most important parts of your travel experience with us, and there are a number of things you can keep in mind to help us operate smoothly and ensure the safety of everyone at the same time.

LUGGAGE

Prior to your flight, we have a number of recommendations to ensure that you are not surprised when checking your bags of proceeding through the airport security screening.

Gander International Airport’s parking structure is divided into metered and paid lot sections. All parking lots are surface lots (open air) and are security patrolled 24-hours a day by the Canadian Corps of Commissionaires. Metered parking rates are $1 per 30 minutes. A minimum purchase of $1 is required. The meters accept coins only.
